*Changes: Added the new scatter plots comparing standard per-capita park access against the CD demographic percentages, made the points present information upon hover.*

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("../code/01_load_dependencies.R")
cd_final <- st_read("../data/processed/cd_final_equity.geojson") %>% filter(TotalPop > 0)

# Download/load the Open Sans font from Google Fonts
font_add_google("Open Sans", "Open Sans")
# Load a standard serif font to stand in for Georgia 
font_add_google("PT Serif", "Georgia") 
# Turn on showtext so ggplot knows to use it
showtext_auto()
```

```{r helper-theme}
# Helper function for interactive scatter plots with similar theme to past work
generate_interactive_scatter <- function(data, y_var, y_label, point_color, y_format_func, title_suffix) {

  # Use tidy evaluation to handle the dynamic y_var
  y_var_enquo <- enquo(y_var)
  
  # Prepare the data with a new multi-line tooltip string
  plot_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      x_rank = rank(facre_pc),
      # Combine all desired info into a single tooltip string.
      # Use HTML <br> for line breaks and <b> for bolding.
      tooltip_text = sprintf(
        "<b>Council District: %s</b><br>Park Access Rank: %d<br>%s: %s",
        councildist,
        x_rank,
        y_label,
        y_format_func({{y_var_enquo}})
      )
    )
  
  # Calculate correlation stats
  test <- cor.test(plot_data$x_rank, plot_data %>% pull({{y_var_enquo}}), use = "complete.obs")
  r_val <- round(test$estimate, 2)
  p_val <- test$p.value
  p_str <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_val))
  stats_label <- paste0("r = ", r_val, "\np = ", p_str)
  
  # Build the ggplot object
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x_rank, y = {{y_var_enquo}})) + 
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "gray50", linetype = "dashed") +
    
    # FIX: Remove the 'onclick' aesthetic entirely. All info is now in the tooltip.
    geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tooltip_text, data_id = councildist),
                           color = point_color, size = 2.5) +
                           
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = stats_label, 
             hjust = -0.2, vjust = 1.3, family = "Open Sans", fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = y_format_func, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))) +
    labs(
      title = "Park Equity in NYC",
      subtitle = paste("Comparing Park Acreage and", title_suffix, "by Council District"),
      x = "Park Acreage (Functional Acreage Per Capita)\nRanked from Least to Greatest",
      y = y_label,
      caption = "Source: Councilcount (ACS); NYC Parks: Walk-to-a-Park"
    ) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Open Sans"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(family = "Georgia", size = 16),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(family = "Georgia", size = 12, margin = margin(b=10)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(t = 10))
    )
    
  return(p)
}
```

```{r correlations}
# Plot & Save
interactive_opts <- list(
  opts_hover(css = "fill:#FFC300;stroke:black;stroke-width:1px;")
)

# --- Plot A: Park Access vs NH White ---
plot_nhw <- generate_interactive_scatter(
  data = cd_final, y_var = Perc_NHWhite, y_label = "Non-Hispanic White (%)", 
  point_color = "#846126", y_format_func = function(y) scales::percent(y, scale=1), 
  title_suffix = "Race"
)
interactive_plot_nhw <- girafe(ggobj = plot_nhw, width_svg = 10, height_svg = 6, options = interactive_opts)
print(interactive_plot_nhw)
saveWidget(interactive_plot_nhw, file = "../figures2/cd_acreage_race_scatter.html")

# --- Plot B: Park Access vs Median Income ---
plot_inc <- generate_interactive_scatter(
  data = cd_final, y_var = MedInc, y_label = "Median Household Income", 
  point_color = "#2f56a6", y_format_func = scales::dollar,
  title_suffix = "Median Income"
)
interactive_plot_inc <- girafe(ggobj = plot_inc, width_svg = 10, height_svg = 6, options = interactive_opts)
print(interactive_plot_inc)
saveWidget(interactive_plot_inc, file = "../figures2/cd_acreage_income_scatter.html")
```
